# Environment-configured database URL with fallback

The database connection URL is read from the KC_DATABASE_URL environment variable; if KC_DATABASE_URL is not set, the code uses the hardcoded DEFAULT_DATABASE_URL value 'postgresql+psycopg://kc:kc@localhost:5432/knowledge'.

Allow runtime configuration of the database endpoint via environment variables while providing a working local default for development or docker-based setups.
